request.notes: float64 world (jax_enable_x64) on the GPU with jax.vmap (w4.make_runners, checked against WindWorld's lax.map runner: 1e-14 at tick 1 on CPU), float32 nets. About 300k member-ticks of simulation, then 8 closure analyses in parallel (numpy on the pod CPU, JAX nets on the GPU). CPU smoke tests passed: tiny simulations, every analysis on a fixture of existing data, and job.sh end to end from a git archive of exactly these paths.
request.purpose: Round-4 wind study: full-size gliders wind-world certification (F vs M closure at the fresh layout, 2nd F/M pair, MW oracle cost, program-mix set P with input-aware patchnet/slotnet and energy scores)
request.setup:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH
uv venv -q -p 3.12 $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv && . $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -q 'jax[cuda12]==0.12.0.1' numpy==2.5.4 scipy==1.18.0
